    CONCHO, CORYELL, LAMPASAS, LLANO, MASON,
    MCCULLOCH, MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN SABA,
SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES




                           SOAH ORDER NO. 34
                         NOTICE TO THE PARTIES


      The State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) Administrative Law
Judges (ALJs) issued a Proposal for Decision (PFD) in this docket on
August 20, 2026. Subsequently, the parties timely filed exceptions and replies to
that PFD.
       At its September 11, 2026 Open Meeting, the Public Utility Commission of
Texas (Commission) voted to remand the PFD back to SOAH for further processing
on limited, specific issues. Although the Commission’s formal written remand order
has not yet been issued, the ALJs are deferring the issuance of their letter of
exceptions to allow for the processing of the remand.


      To ensure administrative efficiency and a complete record, the ALJs will
handle exceptions and replies as follows:

      • August PFD Exceptions: The ALJs have received and reviewed all
        exceptions and replies to the August 20, 2026 PFD. These existing
        arguments are preserved and will be addressed in the ALJs’ final
        exceptions letter.
      • Remand PFD and Future Exceptions: The evidentiary record will not be
        reopened. Following proceedings on remand, the ALJs will issue a
        supplemental PFD addressing only the limited issues identified in the
        Commission’s remand order. Afterward, the parties will have an
        opportunity to file exceptions and replies strictly limited to those new
        remand issues.
      • Final Exceptions Letter: After the close of the remand exceptions period,
        the ALJs will issue a single, comprehensive exceptions letter addressing
        the exceptions and replies from both the August PFD and the remand
        PFD.

Signed September 15, 2026

_________________________                        ________________________
Linda Brite                                      Linda J. Burgess
Presiding Administrative Law Judge               Presiding Administrative Law Judge

Dee Marlo Chico
